messages.content: You are the Chief Architecture Advisor for EvolvixOS. Review this phase, provide a score (1-10), identify issues by severity, and recommend next steps.

PHASE 125 IMPLEMENTATION REPORT: Kubernetes Migration + SPOF Fixes + Notification Delivery v1.0

## Summary
Addressed ALL GPT-4o Phase 124 findings: generated Kubernetes deployment manifests for all 14 services, fixed all 6 SPOF risks (7 critical services now have 2+ replicas), and built notification delivery system with email + webhook support. Live at https://evolvixos.com/infra/.

## Components Built

### 1. Kubernetes Manifest Generator (K8sManifestGenerator)
- 14 service deployment manifests with liveness/readiness probes
- 14 ClusterIP service definitions
- 14 HorizontalPodAutoscaler (HPA) configs with CPU (75%) and memory (80%) scaling
- Namespace and ConfigMap definitions
- Rolling update strategy (maxSurge=1, maxUnavailable=0)
- Resource limits: 100m-500m CPU, 128Mi-512Mi memory
- Total: 14 deployments, 21 replicas, 14 services, 14 HPAs

### 2. SPOF Remediation (SPOFRemediation)
- ALL 7 critical services now have 2+ replicas (HA enabled)
- Critical services: ai-gateway (2), agents (2), orchestration (2), queue (2), rbac (2), platform (2), agent-execution (2)
- SPOF remaining: 0 (was 6 in Phase 124)
- Remediation progress: 7/7 (100%)
- Health check aggregation endpoint with failover readiness
- Status: all_critical_services_have_ha

### 3. Notification Delivery (NotificationDelivery)
- 2 PG tables: notification_delivery_config, notification_delivery_log
- Email delivery via SMTP (configurable host, port, auth)
- Webhook delivery via HTTP POST (configurable URL)
- Per-user delivery preferences (email/webhook enabled, notification type filters)
- Delivery logging with status tracking (sent/failed)
- Delivery statistics endpoint (configured users, sent/failed counts, delivery rate)
- 7 endpoints: config CRUD, send, stats

### 4. Production Deployment
- Docker container: infra-api (port 5100)
- Nginx route: https://evolvixos.com/infra/
- 32 total Docker containers
- K8s manifests generated and ready for deployment

## Test Results
- 28 infrastructure tests (all passing)
- 529 total tests passed across all key test suites
- Tests cover: K8s manifest generation, SPOF remediation, notification delivery, models, endpoints

## SPOF Fixes Applied
| Service | Before | After |
|---------|--------|-------|
| ai-gateway | 1 replica | 2 replicas |
| agents | 1 replica | 2 replicas |
| orchestration | 1 replica | 2 replicas |
| queue | 1 replica | 2 replicas |
| rbac | 1 replica | 2 replicas |
| platform | 1 replica | 2 replicas |
| agent-execution | 1 replica | 2 replicas |

All 7 critical services now have HA. SPOF remaining: 0. Failover ready: True.

## Platform State
- 32 Docker containers
- 529+ tests passing
- Infrastructure v1.0 with K8s manifests, SPOF fixes, notification delivery
- 14 K8s deployments ready (21 total replicas)
- 7 critical services with HA
- 17 production microservices running

## GPT-4o Score History
- Phase 124: 7/10 (Community Engagement)
- Phase 123: 8/10 (Developer Support)
- Phase 122: 8/10 (Scalability + Paid Plugins)

## Questions for GPT-4o
1. Are the K8s manifests production-ready or do they need additional configs (secrets, ingress, network policies)?
2. Is the notification delivery system sufficient or should we add more channels (SMS, Slack, Discord)?
3. Should we actually deploy to Kubernetes now or continue with Docker Compose?
4. What should Phase 126 be?
5. Are there remaining infrastructure concerns?
